A CSS class name where all bindings will be attached to. Multiple
charts on the same page should have separate class names to prevent
duplicating events.

Default value of versions < 7.0.4 `highcharts-bindings-wrapper`

name: navigation-buttonOptions
title: buttonOptions
description:
A collection of options for buttons appearing in the exporting
module.

In styled mode, the buttons are styled with the
`.highcharts-contextbutton` and `.highcharts-button-symbol` classes.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-align
title: align
description: Alignment for the buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-buttonSpacing
title: buttonSpacing
description:
The pixel spacing between buttons, and between the context button and
the title.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-enabled
title: enabled
description: Whether to enable buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-height
title: height
description: Pixel height of the buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolFill
title: symbolFill
description: Fill color for the symbol within the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolSize
title: symbolSize
description: The pixel size of the symbol on the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolStroke
title: symbolStroke
description: The color of the symbol's stroke or line.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolStrokeWidth
title: symbolStrokeWidth
description: The pixel stroke width of the symbol on the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolX
title: symbolX
description: The x position of the center of the symbol inside the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-symbolY
title: symbolY
description: The y position of the center of the symbol inside the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-text
title: text
description: A text string to add to the individual button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme
title: theme
description:
A configuration object for the button theme. The object accepts
SVG properties like `stroke-width`, `stroke` and `fill`.
Tri-state button styles are supported by the `states.hover` and
`states.select` objects.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-fill
title: fill
description: The default fill exists only to capture hover events.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-padding
title: padding
description: Padding for the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-states
title: states
description: Tri-state button styles.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-states-disabled
title: disabled
description: SVG attributes for the disabled state of the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-states-hover
title: hover
description: SVG attributes for the hovered state of the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-states-select
title: select
description: SVG attributes for the selected state of the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-stroke
title: stroke
description: Default stroke for the buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-stroke-linecap
title: stroke-linecap
description: Default stroke linecap for the buttons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-theme-style
title: style
description: CSS styling for the button's text or symbol.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to use HTML for rendering the button. HTML allows for things
like inline CSS or image-based icons.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
The vertical alignment of the buttons. Can be one of `"top"`,
`"middle"` or `"bottom"`.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-width
title: width
description: The pixel width of the button.

name: navigation-buttonOptions-y
title: y
description:
The vertical offset of the button's position relative to its
`verticalAlign`. By default adjusted for the chart title alignment.

name: navigation-events
title: events
description: Events to communicate between Stock Tools and custom GUI.

name: navigation-events-closePopup
title: closePopup
description:
A `closePopup` event. Fired when Popup should be hidden, for example
when clicking on an annotation again.

name: navigation-events-deselectButton
title: deselectButton
description:
Event fired when button state should change, for example after
adding an annotation.

name: navigation-events-selectButton
title: selectButton
description: Event fired on a button click.

name: navigation-events-showPopup
title: showPopup
description: A `showPopup` event. Fired when selecting for example an annotation.

name: navigation-iconsURL
title: iconsURL
description:
Path where Highcharts will look for icons. Change this to use icons
from a different server. When undefined, icons are loaded from
the library's internal source.

name: navigation-menuItemHoverStyle
title: menuItemHoverStyle
description:
CSS styles for the hover state of the individual items within the
popup menu appearing by default when the export icon is clicked. The
menu items are rendered in HTML.

name: navigation-menuItemStyle
title: menuItemStyle
description:
CSS styles for the individual items within the popup menu appearing
by default when the export icon is clicked. The menu items are
rendered in HTML. Font size defaults to `11px` on desktop and `14px`
on touch devices.

name: navigation-menuStyle
title: menuStyle
description:
CSS styles for the popup menu appearing by default when the export
icon is clicked. This menu is rendered in HTML.

name: navigator
title: navigator
description:
The navigator is a small series below the main series, displaying
a view of the entire data set. It provides tools to zoom in and
out on parts of the data as well as panning across the dataset.

name: navigator-accessibility
title: accessibility
description:
Accessibility options for the navigator. Requires the
Accessibility module.

name: navigator-accessibility-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable accessibility support for the navigator.

name: navigator-adaptToUpdatedData
title: adaptToUpdatedData
description:
Whether the navigator and scrollbar should adapt to updated data
in the base X axis. When loading data async, as in the demo below,
this should be `false`. Otherwise new data will trigger navigator
redraw, which will cause unwanted looping. In the demo below, the
data in the navigator is set only once. On navigating, only the main
chart content is updated.

name: navigator-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable or disable the navigator.

name: navigator-handles
title: handles
description: Options for the handles for dragging the zoomed area.

name: navigator-handles-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description: The fill for the handle.

name: navigator-handles-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The stroke for the handle border and the stripes inside.

name: navigator-handles-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description: Border radius of the handles.

name: navigator-handles-enabled
title: enabled
description: Allows to enable/disable handles.

name: navigator-handles-height
title: height
description: Height for handles.

name: navigator-handles-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description: The width for the handle border and the stripes inside.

name: navigator-handles-symbols
title: symbols
description:
Array to define shapes of handles. 0-index for left, 1-index for
right.

Additionally, the URL to a graphic can be given on this form:
`url(graphic.png)`. Note that for the image to be applied to
exported charts, its URL needs to be accessible by the export
server.

Custom callbacks for symbol path generation can also be added to
`Highcharts.SVGRenderer.prototype.symbols`. The callback is then
used by its method name, as shown in the demo.

name: navigator-handles-width
title: width
description: Width for handles.

name: navigator-height
title: height
description: The height of the navigator.

name: navigator-margin
title: margin
description: The distance from the nearest element, the X axis or X axis labels.

name: navigator-maskFill
title: maskFill
description:
The color of the mask covering the areas of the navigator series
that are currently not visible in the main series. The default
color is bluish with an opacity of 0.3 to see the series below.

name: navigator-maskInside
title: maskInside
description:
Whether the mask should be inside the range marking the zoomed
range, or outside. In Highcharts Stock 1.x it was always `false`.

name: navigator-opposite
title: opposite
description:
When the chart is inverted, whether to draw the navigator on the
opposite side.

name: navigator-outlineColor
title: outlineColor
description:
The color of the line marking the currently zoomed area in the
navigator.

name: navigator-outlineWidth
title: outlineWidth
description:
The width of the line marking the currently zoomed area in the
navigator.

name: navigator-series
title: series

name: navigator-series-color
title: color
description: Sets the color of the navigator series.

name: navigator-series-data
title: data
description:
Unless data is explicitly defined, the data is borrowed from the
first series in the chart.

name: navigator-series-dataGrouping
title: dataGrouping
description: Data grouping options for the navigator series.

name: navigator-series-dataLabels
title: dataLabels
description:
Data label options for the navigator series. Data labels are
disabled by default on the navigator series.

name: navigator-series-fillColor
title: fillColor
description:
Sets the fill color of the navigator series. Applies to series
types with a filled area, like the default `areaspline`.

name: navigator-series-fillOpacity
title: fillOpacity
description: The fill opacity of the navigator series.

name: navigator-series-lineColor
title: lineColor
description:
Line color for the navigator series. Allows setting the color
while disallowing the default candlestick setting.

name: navigator-series-lineWidth
title: lineWidth
description: The pixel line width of the navigator series.

name: navigator-series-pointRange
title: pointRange
description:
Since Highcharts Stock v8, default value is the same as default
`pointRange` defined for a specific type (e.g. `null` for
column type).

In Highcharts Stock version < 8, defaults to 0.

name: navigator-series-threshold
title: threshold
description:
The threshold option. Setting it to 0 will make the default
navigator area series draw its area from the 0 value and up.

name: navigator-series-type
title: type
description:
The type of the navigator series.

Heads up:
In column-type navigator, zooming is limited to at least one
point with its `pointRange`.

name: navigator-stickToMax
title: stickToMax
description:
Enable or disable navigator sticking to right, while adding new
points. If `undefined`, the navigator sticks to the axis maximum only
if it was already at the maximum prior to adding points.

name: navigator-xAxis
title: xAxis

name: navigator-xAxis-accessibility
title: accessibility
description: Accessibility options for an axis. Requires the accessibility module.

name: navigator-xAxis-accessibility-description
title: description
description: Description for an axis to expose to screen reader users.

name: navigator-xAxis-accessibility-enabled
title: enabled
description:
Enable axis accessibility features, including axis information in the
screen reader information region. If this is disabled on the xAxis, the
x values are not exposed to screen readers for the individual data points
by default.

name: navigator-xAxis-accessibility-rangeDescription
title: rangeDescription
description:
Range description for an axis. Overrides the default range description.
Set to empty to disable range description for this axis.

name: navigator-xAxis-alignTicks
title: alignTicks
description:
When using multiple axis, the ticks of two or more opposite axes
will automatically be aligned by adding ticks to the axis or axes
with the least ticks, as if `tickAmount` were specified.

This can be prevented by setting `alignTicks` to false. If the grid
lines look messy, it's a good idea to hide them for the secondary
axis by setting `gridLineWidth` to 0.

If `startOnTick` or `endOnTick` in an Axis options are set to false,
then the `alignTicks ` will be disabled for the Axis.

Disabled for logarithmic axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-allowDecimals
title: allowDecimals
description:
Whether to allow decimals in this axis' ticks. When counting
integers, like persons or hits on a web page, decimals should
be avoided in the labels. By default, decimals are allowed on small
scale axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-alternateGridColor
title: alternateGridColor
description:
When using an alternate grid color, a band is painted across the
plot area between every other grid line.

name: navigator-xAxis-breaks
title: breaks
description:
An array defining breaks in the axis, the sections defined will be
left out and all the points shifted closer to each other.

name: navigator-xAxis-breaks-breakSize
title: breakSize
description:
A number indicating how much space should be left between the start
and the end of the break. The break size is given in axis units,
so for instance on a `datetime` axis, a break size of 3600000 would
indicate the equivalent of an hour.

name: navigator-xAxis-breaks-from
title: from
description:
The axis value where the break starts. On datetime axes, this may be
a date string.

name: navigator-xAxis-breaks-repeat
title: repeat
description:
Defines an interval after which the break appears again. By default
the breaks do not repeat.

name: navigator-xAxis-breaks-to
title: to
description:
The axis value where the break ends. On datetime axes, this may be
a date string.

name: navigator-xAxis-ceiling
title: ceiling
description: The highest allowed value for automatically computed axis extremes.

name: navigator-xAxis-className
title: className
description:
A class name that opens for styling the axis by CSS, especially in
Highcharts styled mode. The class name is applied to group elements
for the grid, axis elements and labels.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-className
title: className
description: A class name for the crosshair, especially as a hook for styling.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-color
title: color
description:
The color of the crosshair. Defaults to `#cccccc` for numeric and
datetime axes, and `rgba(204,214,235,0.25)` for category axes, where
the crosshair by default highlights the whole category.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-dashStyle
title: dashStyle
description:
The dash style for the crosshair. See
[plotOptions.series.dashStyle](#plotOptions.series.dashStyle)
for possible values.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label
title: label
description:
A label on the axis next to the crosshair.

In styled mode, the label is styled with the
`.highcharts-crosshair-label` class.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-align
title: align
description:
Alignment of the label compared to the axis. Defaults to `"left"` for
right-side axes, `"right"` for left-side axes and `"center"` for
horizontal axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description:
The background color for the label. Defaults to the related series
color, or `#666666` if that is not available.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The border color for the crosshair label

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description: The border corner radius of the crosshair label.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: The border width for the crosshair label.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-enabled
title: enabled
description: Flag to enable crosshair's label.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the crosshair label. Defaults to `{value}` for
numeric axes and `{value:%b %d, %Y}` for datetime axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Formatter function for the label text.
Since v12.6.0, the callback also receives `ctx` as the second
argument, so that arrow functions can access the same context as
regular functions using `this`.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-padding
title: padding
description: Padding inside the crosshair label.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-shape
title: shape
description: The shape to use for the label box.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-label-style
title: style
description: Text styles for the crosshair label.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-showDelay
title: showDelay
description:
The number of milliseconds to wait until the crosshair is shown when
the mouse is over a point. Works on initial hover.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-snap
title: snap
description:
Whether the crosshair should snap to the point or follow the pointer
independent of points.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-width
title: width
description:
The pixel width of the crosshair. Defaults to 1 for numeric or
datetime axes, and for one category width for category axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-crosshair-zIndex
title: zIndex
description:
The Z index of the crosshair. Higher Z indices allow drawing the
crosshair on top of the series or behind the grid lines.

name: navigator-xAxis-crossing
title: crossing
description:
The value on a perpendicular axis where this axis should cross. This
is typically used on mathematical plots where the axes cross at 0.
When `crossing` is set, space will not be reserved at the sides of
the chart for axis labels and title, so those may be clipped. In this
case it is better to place the axes without the `crossing` option.

name: navigator-xAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats
title: dateTimeLabelFormats
description:
For a datetime axis, the scale will automatically adjust to the
appropriate unit. This member gives the default representations used
for each unit. For easier data interpretation, `hour`, `day`, `month`
and `year` units can be used and formatted as boundary tick values.
Check boundaries map below to see where to format boundary ticks on
given main time units.

```js
    baseUnit: boundaryUnit
    ----------------------
    millisecond: 'hour',
    second: 'hour',
    minute: 'hour',
    hour: 'day',
    day: 'month',
    week: 'month',
    month: 'year',
    year: 'year'
```

For an overview of the date time label formats configuration, see
[dateFormat](/class-reference/Highcharts.Time#dateFormat).

Defaults to:
```js
{
    millisecond: { main: '%[HMSL]' },
    second: { main: '%[HMS]' },
    minute: { main: '%[HM]' },
    hour: { main: '%[HM]', boundary: undefined },
    day: { main: '%[eb]', boundary: '%[eb]' },
    week: { main: '%[eb]' },
    month: { main: '%[bY]', boundary: undefined },
    year: { main: '%Y', boundary: undefined }
}
```

name: navigator-xAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-day-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: navigator-xAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-day-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-xAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-hour-boundary

description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary

Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary

name: navigator-xAxis-endOnTick
title: endOnTick
description:
Whether to force the axis to end on a tick. Use this option with
the `maxPadding` option to control the axis end.

name: navigator-xAxis-events
title: events
description: Event handlers for the axis.

name: navigator-xAxis-events-afterSetExtremes
title: afterSetExtremes
description:
As opposed to the `setExtremes` event, this event fires after the
final min and max values are computed and corrected for `minRange`.

Fires when the minimum and maximum is set for the axis, either by
calling the `.setExtremes()` method or by selecting an area in the
chart. One parameter, `event`, is passed to the function, containing
common event information.

The new user set minimum and maximum values can be found by
`event.min` and `event.max`. These reflect the axis minimum and
maximum in axis values. The actual data extremes are found in
`event.dataMin` and `event.dataMax`.

name: navigator-xAxis-events-pointInBreak
title: pointInBreak
description: An event fired when a point falls inside a break from this axis.

name: navigator-xAxis-events-setExtremes
title: setExtremes
description:
Fires when the minimum and maximum is set for the axis, either by
calling the `.setExtremes()` method or by selecting an area in the
chart. One parameter, `event`, is passed to the function,
containing common event information.

The new user set minimum and maximum values can be found by
`event.min` and `event.max`. These reflect the axis minimum and
maximum in data values. When an axis is zoomed all the way out from
the "Reset zoom" button, `event.min` and `event.max` are null, and
the new extremes are set based on `this.dataMin` and `this.dataMax`.

name: navigator-xAxis-floor
title: floor
description: The lowest allowed value for automatically computed axis extremes.

name: navigator-xAxis-gridLineDashStyle
title: gridLineDashStyle
description:
The dash or dot style of the grid lines. For possible values, see
[this demonstration](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: navigator-xAxis-gridZIndex
title: gridZIndex
description: The Z index of the grid lines.

name: navigator-xAxis-height
title: height
description:
The height as the vertical axis. If it's a number, it is
interpreted as pixels.

Since Highcharts 2: If it's a percentage string, it is interpreted
as percentages of the total plot height.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description:
Whether to allow the axis labels to overlap. When false,
overlapping labels are hidden.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-autoRotation
title: autoRotation
description:
For horizontal axes, the allowed degrees of label rotation
to prevent overlapping labels. If there is enough space,
labels are not rotated. As the chart gets narrower, it
will start rotating the labels -45 degrees, then remove
every second label and try again with rotations 0 and -45 etc.
Set it to `undefined` to disable rotation, which will
cause the labels to word-wrap if possible. Defaults to `[-45]``
on bottom and top axes, `undefined` on left and right axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-enabled
title: enabled
description: Enable or disable the axis labels.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the axis label. The context is available as
format string variables. For example, you can use `{text}` to
insert the default formatted text. The recommended way of adding
units for the label is using `text`, for example `{text} km`.

To add custom numeric or datetime formatting, use `{value}` with
formatting, for example `{value:.1f}` or `{value:%Y-%m-%d}`.

See
[format string](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting)
for more examples of formatting.

The default value is not specified due to the dynamic
nature of the default implementation.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the label. The value
is given by `this.value`. Additional properties for `this` are
`axis`, `chart`, `isFirst`, `isLast` and `text` which holds the
value of the default formatter. Since v12.6.0, the callback also
receives `ctx` as the first argument, so that arrow functions can
access the same context as regular functions using `this`.

Defaults to a built in function returning a formatted string
depending on whether the axis is `category`, `datetime`,
`numeric` or other.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-overflow
title: overflow
description:
How to handle overflowing labels on horizontal axis. If set to
`"allow"`, it will not be aligned at all. By default it
`"justify"` labels inside the chart area. If there is room to
move it, it will be aligned to the edge, else it will be removed.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-reserveSpace
title: reserveSpace
description:
Whether to reserve space for the labels. By default, space is
reserved for the labels in these cases:

* On all horizontal axes.
* On vertical axes if `label.align` is `right` on a left-side
axis or `left` on a right-side axis.
* On vertical axes if `label.align` is `center`.

This can be turned off when for example the labels are rendered
inside the plot area instead of outside.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-rotation
title: rotation
description:
Rotation of the labels in degrees. When `undefined`, the
`autoRotation` option takes precedence.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-staggerLines
title: staggerLines
description:
Horizontal axes only. The number of lines to spread the labels
over to make room or tighter labels. 0 disables staggering.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-step
title: step
description:
To show only every _n_'th label on the axis, set the step to _n_.
Setting the step to 2 shows every other label.

By default, when 0, the step is calculated automatically to avoid
overlap. To prevent this, set it to 1\. This usually only
happens on a category axis, and is often a sign that you have
chosen the wrong axis type.

Read more at
[Axis docs](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/axes)
=> What axis should I use?

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: navigator-xAxis-labels-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The Z index for the axis labels.

name: navigator-xAxis-left
title: left
description:
The left position as the horizontal axis. If it's a number, it is
interpreted as pixel position relative to the chart.

Since Highcharts v5.0.13: If it's a percentage string, it is
interpreted as percentages of the plot width, offset from plot area
left.

name: navigator-xAxis-lineColor
title: lineColor
description:
The color of the line marking the axis itself.

In styled mode, the line stroke is given in the
`.highcharts-axis-line` or `.highcharts-xaxis-line` class.

name: navigator-xAxis-margin
title: margin
description:
If there are multiple axes on the same side of the chart, the pixel
margin between the axes. Defaults to 0 on vertical axes, 15 on
horizontal axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-max
title: max
description:
The maximum value of the axis. If `undefined`, the max value is
automatically calculated.

If a datetime string is passed, it is parsed into epoch time
according to the time zone given in [time.timezone](#time.timezone).

If the [endOnTick](#yAxis.endOnTick) option is true, the `max` value
might be rounded up.

If a [tickAmount](#yAxis.tickAmount) is set, the axis may be extended
beyond the set max in order to reach the given number of ticks. The
same may happen in a chart with multiple axes, determined by [chart.
alignTicks](#chart), where a `tickAmount` is applied internally.

name: navigator-xAxis-maxPadding
title: maxPadding
description:
Padding of the max value relative to the length of the axis. A
padding of 0.05 will make a 100px axis 5px longer. This is useful
when you don't want the highest data value to appear on the edge
of the plot area. When the axis' `max` option is set or a max extreme
is set using `axis.setExtremes()`, the maxPadding will be ignored.

name: navigator-xAxis-min
title: min
description:
The minimum value of the axis. If `undefined`, the min value is
automatically calculated.

If a datetime string is passed, it is parsed into epoch time
according to the time zone given in [time.timezone](#time.timezone).

If the [startOnTick](#yAxis.startOnTick) option is true (default),
the `min` value might be rounded down.

The automatically calculated minimum value is also affected by
[floor](#yAxis.floor), [softMin](#yAxis.softMin),
[minPadding](#yAxis.minPadding), [minRange](#yAxis.minRange)
as well as [series.threshold](#plotOptions.series.threshold)
and [series.softThreshold](#plotOptions.series.softThreshold).

name: navigator-xAxis-minPadding
title: minPadding
description:
Padding of the min value relative to the length of the axis. A
padding of 0.05 will make a 100px axis 5px longer. This is useful
when you don't want the lowest data value to appear on the edge
of the plot area. When the axis' `min` option is set or a min extreme
is set using `axis.setExtremes()`, the minPadding will be ignored.

name: navigator-xAxis-minTickInterval
title: minTickInterval
description:
The minimum tick interval allowed in axis values. For example on
zooming in on an axis with daily data, this can be used to prevent
the axis from showing hours. Defaults to the closest distance between
two points on the axis.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorGridLineColor
title: minorGridLineColor
description:
Color of the minor, secondary grid lines.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-minor-grid-line` class.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorGridLineDashStyle
title: minorGridLineDashStyle
description:
The dash or dot style of the minor grid lines. For possible values,
see [this demonstration](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: navigator-xAxis-minorGridLineWidth
title: minorGridLineWidth
description:
Width of the minor, secondary grid lines.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-grid-line` class.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorTickColor
title: minorTickColor
description: Color for the minor tick marks.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorTickInterval
title: minorTickInterval
description:
Specific tick interval in axis units for the minor ticks. On a linear
axis, if `"auto"`, the minor tick interval is calculated as a fifth
of the tickInterval. If `undefined`, minor ticks are not shown.

On logarithmic axes, the unit is the power of the value. For example,
setting the minorTickInterval to 1 puts one tick on each of 0.1, 1,
10, 100 etc. Setting the minorTickInterval to 0.1 produces 9 ticks
between 1 and 10, 10 and 100 etc.

If user settings dictate minor ticks to become too dense, they don't
make sense, and will be ignored to prevent performance problems.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorTickLength
title: minorTickLength
description: The pixel length of the minor tick marks.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorTickPosition
title: minorTickPosition
description:
The position of the minor tick marks relative to the axis line.
 Can be one of `inside` and `outside`.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorTickWidth
title: minorTickWidth
description: The pixel width of the minor tick mark.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorTicks
title: minorTicks
description:
Enable or disable minor ticks. The interval between the minor ticks
can be controlled either by the
[minorTicksPerMajor](#xAxis.minorTicksPerMajor) setting, or as an
absolute [minorTickInterval](#xAxis.minorTickInterval) value.

On a logarithmic axis, minor ticks are laid out based on a best
guess, attempting to enter an approximate number of minor ticks
between each major tick based on
[minorTicksPerMajor](#xAxis.minorTicksPerMajor).

Prior to v6.0.0, ticks were enabled in auto layout by setting
`minorTickInterval` to `"auto"`.

name: navigator-xAxis-minorTicksPerMajor
title: minorTicksPerMajor
description:
The number of minor ticks per major tick. Works for `linear`,
`logarithmic` and `datetime` axes.

For radial axes in gauges, the default value is 10.

name: navigator-xAxis-offset
title: offset
description:
The distance in pixels from the plot area to the axis line.
A positive offset moves the axis with its line, labels and ticks
away from the plot area. This is typically used when two or more
axes are displayed on the same side of the plot. With multiple
axes the offset is dynamically adjusted to avoid collision, this
can be overridden by setting offset explicitly.

For radial axes in gauges, the offset can be a percentage string, and
defaults to render the line and ticks on the inside of the pane and
plot bands (since v13). Labels are not affected by the offset in
radial axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-ordinal
title: ordinal
description:
In an ordinal axis, the points are equally spaced in the chart
regardless of the actual time or x distance between them. This means
that missing data periods (e.g. nights or weekends for a stock chart)
will not take up space in the chart.
Having `ordinal: false` will show any gaps created by the `gapSize`
setting proportionate to their duration.

In stock charts the X axis is ordinal by default, unless
the boost module is used and at least one of the series' data length
exceeds the [boostThreshold](#series.line.boostThreshold).

For an ordinal axis, `minPadding` and `maxPadding` are ignored. Use
[overscroll](#xAxis.overscroll) instead.

name: navigator-xAxis-overscroll
title: overscroll
description:
Additional range on the right side of the xAxis. Works similar to
`xAxis.maxPadding`, but the value is set in terms of axis values,
percentage or pixels.

If it's a number, it is interpreted as axis values, which in a
datetime axis equals milliseconds.

If it's a percentage string, is interpreted as percentages of the
axis length. An overscroll of 50% will make a 100px axis 50px longer.

If it's a pixel string, it is interpreted as a fixed pixel value, but
limited to 90% of the axis length.

If it's undefined, the value is inherited from `xAxis.overscroll`.

Can be set for both, main xAxis and navigator's xAxis.

name: navigator-xAxis-panningEnabled
title: panningEnabled
description:
Whether to pan axis. If `chart.panning` is enabled, the option
allows to disable panning on an individual axis.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands
title: plotBands
description:
An array of colored bands stretching across the plot area marking an
interval on the axis.

In styled mode, the plot bands are styled by the `.highcharts-plot-band`
class in addition to the `className` option.

When doing `Chart.update()` or `Axis.update()`, the plot bands are updated
by index or id. The following merging rules apply:
- If `plotBands` are not defined in the new options, all existing plot bands
  are kept.
- If `plotBands` are defined without ids, the existing plot bands are updated
  by index. If the new array has fewer plot bands, the remaining existing
  plot bands are removed. If the new array has more plot bands, the extra
  ones are added. An empty array removes all existing plot bands.
- If `plotBands` are defined with ids, the existing plot bands are matched
  by id, and remaining unmatched existing plot bands are removed.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-acrossPanes
title: acrossPanes
description: Flag to decide if plotBand should be rendered across all panes.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: Border color for the plot band. Also requires `borderWidth` to be set.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description:
Border radius for the plot band. Applies only to gauges. Can be a pixel
value or a percentage, for example `50%`.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: Border width for the plot band. Also requires `borderColor` to be set.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-className
title: className
description:
A custom class name, in addition to the default `highcharts-plot-band`,
to apply to each individual band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-color
title: color
description: The color of the plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-events
title: events
description:
An object defining mouse events for the plot band. Supported properties
are `click`, `mouseover`, `mouseout`, `mousemove`.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-events-click
title: click
description: Click event on a plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-events-mousemove
title: mousemove
description: Mouse move event on a plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-events-mouseout
title: mouseout
description: Mouse out event on the corner of a plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-events-mouseover
title: mouseover
description: Mouse over event on a plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-from
title: from
description:
The start position of the plot band in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-id
title: id
description: An id used for identifying the plot band in Axis.removePlotBand.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label
title: label
description: Text labels for the plot bands

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-align
title: align
description:
Horizontal alignment of the label. Can be one of "left", "center" or
"right".

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description: Whether or not the label can be hidden if it overlaps with another label.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-inside
title: inside
description: Wether or not the text of the label can exceed the width of the label.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-rotation
title: rotation
description: Rotation of the text label in degrees .

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the text label.

In styled mode, the labels are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-band-label` class.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-text
title: text
description: The string text itself. A subset of HTML is supported.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
The text alignment for the label. While `align` determines where the
texts anchor point is placed within the plot band, `textAlign` determines
how the text is aligned against its anchor point. Possible values are
"left", "center" and "right". Defaults to the same as the `align` option.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
Vertical alignment of the label relative to the plot band. Can be one of
"top", "middle" or "bottom".

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-x
title: x
description:
Horizontal position relative the alignment. Default varies by
orientation.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-label-y
title: y
description:
Vertical position of the text baseline relative to the alignment. Default
varies by orientation.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-to
title: to
description:
The end position of the plot band in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotBands-zIndex
title: zIndex
description:
The z index of the plot band within the chart, relative to other
elements. Using the same z index as another element may give
unpredictable results, as the last rendered element will be on top.
Values from 0 to 20 make sense.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines
title: plotLines
description:
An array of lines stretching across the plot area, marking a specific
value on one of the axes.

In styled mode, the plot lines are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-line` class in addition to the `className` option.

When doing `Chart.update()` or `Axis.update()`, the plot lines are updated
by index or id. The following merging rules apply:
- If `plotLines` are not defined in the new options, all existing plot lines
  are kept.
- If `plotLines` are defined without ids, the existing plot lines are updated
  by index. If the new array has fewer plot lines, the remaining existing
  plot lines are removed. If the new array has more plot lines, the extra
  ones are added. An empty array removes all existing plot lines.
- If `plotLines` are defined with ids, the existing plot lines are matched
  by id, and remaining unmatched existing plot lines are removed.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-acrossPanes
title: acrossPanes
description: Flag to decide if plotLine should be rendered across all panes.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-className
title: className
description:
A custom class name, in addition to the default `highcharts-plot-line`,
to apply to each individual line.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-color
title: color
description: The color of the line.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-dashStyle
title: dashStyle
description:
The dashing or dot style for the plot line. For possible values see
[this overview](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-events
title: events
description:
An object defining mouse events for the plot line. Supported
properties are `click`, `mouseover`, `mouseout`, `mousemove`.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-events-click
title: click
description: Click event on a plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-events-mousemove
title: mousemove
description: Mouse move event on a plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-events-mouseout
title: mouseout
description: Mouse out event on the corner of a plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-events-mouseover
title: mouseover
description: Mouse over event on a plot band.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-id
title: id
description: An id used for identifying the plot line in Axis.removePlotLine.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label
title: label
description: Text labels for the plot lines

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-align
title: align
description:
Horizontal alignment of the label. Can be one of "left", "center" or
"right".

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the label. Useful properties like
the value of plot line or the range of plot band (`from` & `to`
properties) can be found in `this.options` object. Since v12.6.0, the
callback also receives `ctx` as the first argument, so that arrow functions
can access the same context as regular functions using `this`.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-rotation
title: rotation
description:
Rotation of the text label in degrees. Defaults to 0 for horizontal plot
lines and 90 for vertical lines.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the text label.

In styled mode, the labels are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-line-label` class.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-text
title: text
description: The text itself. A subset of HTML is supported.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
The text alignment for the label. While `align` determines where the
texts anchor point is placed within the plot band, `textAlign` determines
how the text is aligned against its anchor point. Possible values are
"left", "center" and "right". Defaults to the same as the `align` option.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
Vertical alignment of the label relative to the plot line. Can be
one of "top", "middle" or "bottom".

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-x
title: x
description:
Horizontal position relative the alignment. Default varies by
orientation.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-label-y
title: y
description:
Vertical position of the text baseline relative to the alignment. Default
varies by orientation.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-labels-clip
title: clip
description: Whether to hide labels that are outside the plot area.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-value
title: value
description:
The position of the line in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-width
title: width
description: The width or thickness of the plot line.

name: navigator-xAxis-plotLines-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The z index of the plot line within the chart.

name: navigator-xAxis-reversed
title: reversed
description:
Whether to reverse the axis so that the highest number is closest
to the origin. If the chart is inverted, the x axis is reversed by
default.

name: navigator-xAxis-reversedStacks
title: reversedStacks
description:
This option determines how stacks should be ordered within a group.
For example reversed xAxis also reverses stacks, so first series
comes last in a group. To keep order like for non-reversed xAxis
enable this option.

name: navigator-xAxis-showFirstLabel
title: showFirstLabel
description: Whether to show the first tick label.

name: navigator-xAxis-showLastLabel
title: showLastLabel
description:
Whether to show the last tick label. Defaults to `true` on cartesian
charts, and `false` on polar charts.

name: navigator-xAxis-softMax
title: softMax
description:
A soft maximum for the axis. If the series data maximum is less than
this, the axis will stay at this maximum, but if the series data
maximum is higher, the axis will flex to show all data.

name: navigator-xAxis-softMin
title: softMin
description:
A soft minimum for the axis. If the series data minimum is greater
than this, the axis will stay at this minimum, but if the series
data minimum is lower, the axis will flex to show all data.

name: navigator-xAxis-startOfWeek
title: startOfWeek
description:
For datetime axes, this decides where to put the tick between weeks.
 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday.

name: navigator-xAxis-startOnTick
title: startOnTick
description:
Whether to force the axis to start on a tick. Use this option with
the `minPadding` option to control the axis start.

name: navigator-xAxis-staticScale
title: staticScale
description:
For vertical axes only. Setting the static scale ensures that each tick unit
is translated into a fixed pixel height. For example, setting the static
scale to 24 results in each Y axis category taking up 24 pixels, and the
height of the chart adjusts. Adding or removing items will make the chart
resize.

name: navigator-xAxis-tickAmount
title: tickAmount
description:
The amount of ticks to draw on the axis. This opens up for aligning
the ticks of multiple charts or panes within a chart. This option
overrides the `tickPixelInterval` option.

This option only has an effect on linear axes. Datetime, logarithmic
or category axes are not affected.

name: navigator-xAxis-tickColor
title: tickColor
description:
Color for the main tick marks.

In styled mode, the stroke is given in the `.highcharts-tick`
class.

name: navigator-xAxis-tickInterval
title: tickInterval
description:
The interval of the tick marks in axis units. When `undefined`, the
tick interval is computed to approximately follow the
[tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) on linear and datetime
axes. On categorized axes, a `undefined` tickInterval will default to
1, one category. Note that datetime axes are based on milliseconds,
so for example an interval of one day is expressed as
`24 * 3600 * 1000`.

On logarithmic axes, the tickInterval is based on powers, so a
tickInterval of 1 means one tick on each of 0.1, 1, 10, 100 etc. A
tickInterval of 2 means a tick of 0.1, 10, 1000 etc. A tickInterval
of 0.2 puts a tick on 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 20,
40 etc.


If the tickInterval is too dense for labels to be drawn, Highcharts
may remove ticks.

If the chart has multiple axes, the [alignTicks](#chart.alignTicks)
option may interfere with the `tickInterval` setting.

name: navigator-xAxis-tickPosition
title: tickPosition
description:
The position of the major tick marks relative to the axis line.
Can be one of `inside` and `outside`.

name: navigator-xAxis-tickPositioner
title: tickPositioner
description:
A callback function returning array defining where the ticks are
laid out on the axis. This overrides the default behavior of
[tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) and [tickInterval](#xAxis.tickInterval). The automatic tick positions are accessible
through `this.tickPositions` and can be modified by the callback.
Since v12.6.0, the callback also receives `ctx` as the third
argument, so that arrow functions can access the same context as
regular functions using `this`.

name: navigator-xAxis-tickPositions
title: tickPositions
description:
An array defining where the ticks are laid out on the axis. This
overrides the default behavior of [tickPixelInterval](#xAxis.tickPixelInterval) and [tickInterval](#xAxis.tickInterval).

Note: When working with date-time axes, be aware of time zone
handling. See the [documentation on time options](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/axes#datetime)
for best practices.

name: navigator-xAxis-tickWidth
title: tickWidth
description:
The pixel width of the major tick marks. Defaults to 0 on category
axes, otherwise 1.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the `.highcharts-tick`
class, but in order for the element to be generated on category axes,
the option must be explicitly set to 1.

name: navigator-xAxis-title
title: title
description: The axis title, showing next to the axis line.

name: navigator-xAxis-title-align
title: align
description:
Alignment of the title relative to the axis values. Possible
values are "low", "middle" or "high".

name: navigator-xAxis-title-margin
title: margin
description:
The pixel distance between the axis labels or line and the title.
Defaults to 0 for horizontal axes, 10 for vertical

name: navigator-xAxis-title-offset
title: offset
description:
The distance from the plot area to the axis line. A positive
offset moves the axis with its line, labels and ticks away from
the plot area. With multiple axes the offset is dynamically
adjusted to avoid collision, this can be overridden by setting
offset explicitly.

For radial axes in gauges, the offset can be a percentage string,
and defaults to render the line and ticks on the inside of the
pane and plot bands (since v13). Labels are not affected by the
offset in radial axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-title-reserveSpace
title: reserveSpace
description: Whether to reserve space for the title when laying out the axis.

name: navigator-xAxis-title-rotation
title: rotation
description:
The rotation of the text in degrees. 0 is horizontal, 270 is
vertical reading from bottom to top. Defaults to 0 for horizontal
axes, 270 for left-side axes and 90 for right-side axes.

name: navigator-xAxis-title-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the title. If the title text is longer than the
axis length, it will wrap to multiple lines by default. This can
be customized by setting the `lineClamp` property, by setting a
specific `width` or by setting `whiteSpace: 'nowrap'`.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-axis-title` class.

name: navigator-xAxis-title-text
title: text
description:
The actual text of the axis title. It can contain basic HTML tags
like `b`, `i` and `span` with style.

name: navigator-xAxis-title-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
Alignment of the text, can be `"left"`, `"right"` or `"center"`.
Default alignment depends on the
[title.align](xAxis.title.align):

Horizontal axes:
- for `align` = `"low"`, `textAlign` is set to `left`
- for `align` = `"middle"`, `textAlign` is set to `center`
- for `align` = `"high"`, `textAlign` is set to `right`

Vertical axes:
- for `align` = `"low"` and `opposite` = `true`, `textAlign` is
  set to `right`
- for `align` = `"low"` and `opposite` = `false`, `textAlign` is
  set to `left`
- for `align` = `"middle"`, `textAlign` is set to `center`
- for `align` = `"high"` and `opposite` = `true` `textAlign` is
  set to `left`
- for `align` = `"high"` and `opposite` = `false` `textAlign` is
  set to `right`

name: navigator-xAxis-title-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the axis title.

name: navigator-xAxis-title-x
title: x
description: Horizontal pixel offset of the title position.

name: navigator-xAxis-title-y
title: y
description: Vertical pixel offset of the title position.

name: navigator-xAxis-top
title: top
description:
The top position as the vertical axis. If it's a number, it is
interpreted as pixel position relative to the chart.

Since Highcharts 2: If it's a percentage string, it is interpreted
as percentages of the plot height, offset from plot area top.

name: navigator-xAxis-units
title: units
description:
Datetime axis only. An array determining what time intervals the
ticks are allowed to fall on. Each array item is an array where the
first value is the time unit and the second value another array of
allowed multiples.

Defaults to:
```js
units: [[
    'millisecond', // unit name
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100, 200, 500] // allowed multiples
], [
    'second',
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30]
], [
    'minute',
    [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30]
], [
    'hour',
    [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12]
], [
    'day',
    [1, 2]
], [
    'week',
    [1, 2]
], [
    'month',
    [1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
], [
    'year',
    null
]]
```

name: navigator-xAxis-visible
title: visible
description:
Whether axis, including axis title, line, ticks and labels, should
be visible.

name: navigator-xAxis-width
title: width
description:
The width as the horizontal axis. If it's a number, it is interpreted
as pixels.

Since Highcharts v5.0.13: If it's a percentage string, it is
interpreted as percentages of the total plot width.

name: navigator-xAxis-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The Z index for the axis group.

name: navigator-xAxis-zoomEnabled
title: zoomEnabled
description:
Whether to zoom axis. If `chart.zoomType` is set, the option allows
to disable zooming on an individual axis.

name: navigator-yAxis
title: yAxis

name: navigator-yAxis-accessibility
title: accessibility
description: Accessibility options for an axis. Requires the accessibility module.

name: navigator-yAxis-accessibility-description
title: description
description: Description for an axis to expose to screen reader users.

name: navigator-yAxis-accessibility-enabled
title: enabled
description:
Enable axis accessibility features, including axis information in the
screen reader information region. If this is disabled on the xAxis, the
x values are not exposed to screen readers for the individual data points
by default.

name: navigator-yAxis-accessibility-rangeDescription
title: rangeDescription
description:
Range description for an axis. Overrides the default range description.
Set to empty to disable range description for this axis.

name: navigator-yAxis-alignTicks
title: alignTicks
description:
When using multiple axis, the ticks of two or more opposite axes
will automatically be aligned by adding ticks to the axis or axes
with the least ticks, as if `tickAmount` were specified.

This can be prevented by setting `alignTicks` to false. If the grid
lines look messy, it's a good idea to hide them for the secondary
axis by setting `gridLineWidth` to 0.

If `startOnTick` or `endOnTick` in an Axis options are set to false,
then the `alignTicks ` will be disabled for the Axis.

Disabled for logarithmic axes.

name: navigator-yAxis-allowDecimals
title: allowDecimals
description:
Whether to allow decimals in this axis' ticks. When counting
integers, like persons or hits on a web page, decimals should
be avoided in the labels. By default, decimals are allowed on small
scale axes.

name: navigator-yAxis-alternateGridColor
title: alternateGridColor
description:
When using an alternate grid color, a band is painted across the
plot area between every other grid line.

name: navigator-yAxis-breaks
title: breaks
description:
An array defining breaks in the axis, the sections defined will be
left out and all the points shifted closer to each other.

name: navigator-yAxis-breaks-breakSize
title: breakSize
description:
A number indicating how much space should be left between the start
and the end of the break. The break size is given in axis units,
so for instance on a `datetime` axis, a break size of 3600000 would
indicate the equivalent of an hour.

name: navigator-yAxis-breaks-from
title: from
description:
The axis value where the break starts. On datetime axes, this may be
a date string.

name: navigator-yAxis-breaks-repeat
title: repeat
description:
Defines an interval after which the break appears again. By default
the breaks do not repeat.

name: navigator-yAxis-breaks-to
title: to
description:
The axis value where the break ends. On datetime axes, this may be
a date string.

name: navigator-yAxis-ceiling
title: ceiling
description: The highest allowed value for automatically computed axis extremes.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-className
title: className
description: A class name for the crosshair, especially as a hook for styling.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-color
title: color
description:
The color of the crosshair. Defaults to `#cccccc` for numeric and
datetime axes, and `rgba(204,214,235,0.25)` for category axes, where
the crosshair by default highlights the whole category.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-dashStyle
title: dashStyle
description:
The dash style for the crosshair. See
[plotOptions.series.dashStyle](#plotOptions.series.dashStyle)
for possible values.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label
title: label
description:
A label on the axis next to the crosshair.

In styled mode, the label is styled with the
`.highcharts-crosshair-label` class.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-align
title: align
description:
Alignment of the label compared to the axis. Defaults to `"left"` for
right-side axes, `"right"` for left-side axes and `"center"` for
horizontal axes.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-backgroundColor
title: backgroundColor
description:
The background color for the label. Defaults to the related series
color, or `#666666` if that is not available.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: The border color for the crosshair label

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description: The border corner radius of the crosshair label.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: The border width for the crosshair label.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-enabled
title: enabled
description: Flag to enable crosshair's label.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the crosshair label. Defaults to `{value}` for
numeric axes and `{value:%b %d, %Y}` for datetime axes.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Formatter function for the label text.
Since v12.6.0, the callback also receives `ctx` as the second
argument, so that arrow functions can access the same context as
regular functions using `this`.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-padding
title: padding
description: Padding inside the crosshair label.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-shape
title: shape
description: The shape to use for the label box.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-label-style
title: style
description: Text styles for the crosshair label.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-showDelay
title: showDelay
description:
The number of milliseconds to wait until the crosshair is shown when
the mouse is over a point. Works on initial hover.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-snap
title: snap
description:
Whether the crosshair should snap to the point or follow the pointer
independent of points.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-width
title: width
description:
The pixel width of the crosshair. Defaults to 1 for numeric or
datetime axes, and for one category width for category axes.

name: navigator-yAxis-crosshair-zIndex
title: zIndex
description:
The Z index of the crosshair. Higher Z indices allow drawing the
crosshair on top of the series or behind the grid lines.

name: navigator-yAxis-crossing
title: crossing
description:
The value on a perpendicular axis where this axis should cross. This
is typically used on mathematical plots where the axes cross at 0.
When `crossing` is set, space will not be reserved at the sides of
the chart for axis labels and title, so those may be clipped. In this
case it is better to place the axes without the `crossing` option.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats
title: dateTimeLabelFormats
description:
For a datetime axis, the scale will automatically adjust to the
appropriate unit. This member gives the default representations used
for each unit. For easier data interpretation, `hour`, `day`, `month`
and `year` units can be used and formatted as boundary tick values.
Check boundaries map below to see where to format boundary ticks on
given main time units.

```js
    baseUnit: boundaryUnit
    ----------------------
    millisecond: 'hour',
    second: 'hour',
    minute: 'hour',
    hour: 'day',
    day: 'month',
    week: 'month',
    month: 'year',
    year: 'year'
```

For an overview of the date time label formats configuration, see
[dateFormat](/class-reference/Highcharts.Time#dateFormat).

Defaults to:
```js
{
    millisecond: { main: '%[HMSL]' },
    second: { main: '%[HMS]' },
    minute: { main: '%[HM]' },
    hour: { main: '%[HM]', boundary: undefined },
    day: { main: '%[eb]', boundary: '%[eb]' },
    week: { main: '%[eb]' },
    month: { main: '%[bY]', boundary: undefined },
    year: { main: '%Y', boundary: undefined }
}
```

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-day-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-day-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-hour-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-hour-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-millisecond-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-minute-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-month-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-month-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-second-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-week-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-year-boundary
title: boundary
description:
Label format that should be used when a tick is a boundary
tick, e.g. start of day, start of year, etc.

name: navigator-yAxis-dateTimeLabelFormats-year-list
title: list
description: List of possible format strings used for this unit.

name: navigator-yAxis-events
title: events
description: Event handlers for the axis.

name: navigator-yAxis-events-afterSetExtremes
title: afterSetExtremes
description:
As opposed to the `setExtremes` event, this event fires after the
final min and max values are computed and corrected for `minRange`.

Fires when the minimum and maximum is set for the axis, either by
calling the `.setExtremes()` method or by selecting an area in the
chart. One parameter, `event`, is passed to the function, containing
common event information.

The new user set minimum and maximum values can be found by
`event.min` and `event.max`. These reflect the axis minimum and
maximum in axis values. The actual data extremes are found in
`event.dataMin` and `event.dataMax`.

name: navigator-yAxis-events-pointInBreak
title: pointInBreak
description: An event fired when a point falls inside a break from this axis.

name: navigator-yAxis-events-setExtremes
title: setExtremes
description:
Fires when the minimum and maximum is set for the axis, either by
calling the `.setExtremes()` method or by selecting an area in the
chart. One parameter, `event`, is passed to the function,
containing common event information.

The new user set minimum and maximum values can be found by
`event.min` and `event.max`. These reflect the axis minimum and
maximum in data values. When an axis is zoomed all the way out from
the "Reset zoom" button, `event.min` and `event.max` are null, and
the new extremes are set based on `this.dataMin` and `this.dataMax`.

name: navigator-yAxis-floor
title: floor
description: The lowest allowed value for automatically computed axis extremes.

name: navigator-yAxis-gridLineColor
title: gridLineColor
description:
Color of the grid lines extending the ticks across the plot area.

In styled mode, the stroke is given in the `.highcharts-grid-line`
class.

name: navigator-yAxis-gridLineDashStyle
title: gridLineDashStyle
description:
The dash or dot style of the grid lines. For possible values, see
[this demonstration](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: navigator-yAxis-gridZIndex
title: gridZIndex
description: The Z index of the grid lines.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-align
title: align
description:
What part of the string the given position is anchored to. Can
be one of `"left"`, `"center"` or `"right"`. The exact position
also depends on the `labels.x` setting.

Angular gauges and solid gauges defaults to `"center"`.
Solid gauges with two labels have additional option `"auto"`
for automatic horizontal and vertical alignment.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description:
Whether to allow the axis labels to overlap. When false,
overlapping labels are hidden.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-autoRotation
title: autoRotation
description:
For horizontal axes, the allowed degrees of label rotation
to prevent overlapping labels. If there is enough space,
labels are not rotated. As the chart gets narrower, it
will start rotating the labels -45 degrees, then remove
every second label and try again with rotations 0 and -45 etc.
Set it to `undefined` to disable rotation, which will
cause the labels to word-wrap if possible. Defaults to `[-45]``
on bottom and top axes, `undefined` on left and right axes.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-format
title: format
description:
A format string for the axis label. The context is available as
format string variables. For example, you can use `{text}` to
insert the default formatted text. The recommended way of adding
units for the label is using `text`, for example `{text} km`.

To add custom numeric or datetime formatting, use `{value}` with
formatting, for example `{value:.1f}` or `{value:%Y-%m-%d}`.

See
[format string](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting)
for more examples of formatting.

The default value is not specified due to the dynamic
nature of the default implementation.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-formatter
title: formatter
description:
Callback JavaScript function to format the label. The value
is given by `this.value`. Additional properties for `this` are
`axis`, `chart`, `isFirst`, `isLast` and `text` which holds the
value of the default formatter. Since v12.6.0, the callback also
receives `ctx` as the first argument, so that arrow functions can
access the same context as regular functions using `this`.

Defaults to a built in function returning a formatted string
depending on whether the axis is `category`, `datetime`,
`numeric` or other.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-overflow
title: overflow
description:
How to handle overflowing labels on horizontal axis. If set to
`"allow"`, it will not be aligned at all. By default it
`"justify"` labels inside the chart area. If there is room to
move it, it will be aligned to the edge, else it will be removed.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-reserveSpace
title: reserveSpace
description:
Whether to reserve space for the labels. By default, space is
reserved for the labels in these cases:

* On all horizontal axes.
* On vertical axes if `label.align` is `right` on a left-side
axis or `left` on a right-side axis.
* On vertical axes if `label.align` is `center`.

This can be turned off when for example the labels are rendered
inside the plot area instead of outside.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-rotation
title: rotation
description:
Rotation of the labels in degrees. When `undefined`, the
`autoRotation` option takes precedence.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-staggerLines
title: staggerLines
description:
Horizontal axes only. The number of lines to spread the labels
over to make room or tighter labels. 0 disables staggering.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-step
title: step
description:
To show only every _n_'th label on the axis, set the step to _n_.
Setting the step to 2 shows every other label.

By default, when 0, the step is calculated automatically to avoid
overlap. To prevent this, set it to 1\. This usually only
happens on a category axis, and is often a sign that you have
chosen the wrong axis type.

Read more at
[Axis docs](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/axes)
=> What axis should I use?

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the label. Use `lineClamp` to control wrapping of
category labels. Use `textOverflow: 'none'` to prevent ellipsis
(dots).

In styled mode, the labels are styled with the
`.highcharts-axis-labels` class.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-x
title: x
description:
The x position offset of all labels relative to the tick
positions on the axis. Defaults to -15 for left axis, 15 for
right axis.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-y
title: y
description:
The y position offset of all labels relative to the tick
positions on the axis. For polar and radial axis consider the use
of the [distance](#yAxis.labels.distance) option.

name: navigator-yAxis-labels-zIndex
title: zIndex
description: The Z index for the axis labels.

name: navigator-yAxis-left
title: left
description:
The left position as the horizontal axis. If it's a number, it is
interpreted as pixel position relative to the chart.

Since Highcharts v5.0.13: If it's a percentage string, it is
interpreted as percentages of the plot width, offset from plot area
left.

name: navigator-yAxis-lineColor
title: lineColor
description:
The color of the line marking the axis itself.

In styled mode, the line stroke is given in the
`.highcharts-axis-line` or `.highcharts-xaxis-line` class.

name: navigator-yAxis-margin
title: margin
description:
If there are multiple axes on the same side of the chart, the pixel
margin between the axes. Defaults to 0 on vertical axes, 15 on
horizontal axes.

name: navigator-yAxis-minTickInterval
title: minTickInterval
description:
The minimum tick interval allowed in axis values. For example on
zooming in on an axis with daily data, this can be used to prevent
the axis from showing hours. Defaults to the closest distance between
two points on the axis.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorGridLineColor
title: minorGridLineColor
description:
Color of the minor, secondary grid lines.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-minor-grid-line` class.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorGridLineDashStyle
title: minorGridLineDashStyle
description:
The dash or dot style of the minor grid lines. For possible values,
see [this demonstration](https://jsfiddle.net/gh/get/library/pure/highcharts/highcharts/tree/master/samples/highcharts/plotoptions/series-dashstyle-all/).

name: navigator-yAxis-minorGridLineWidth
title: minorGridLineWidth
description:
Width of the minor, secondary grid lines.

In styled mode, the stroke width is given in the
`.highcharts-grid-line` class.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorTickColor
title: minorTickColor
description: Color for the minor tick marks.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorTickInterval
title: minorTickInterval
description:
Specific tick interval in axis units for the minor ticks. On a linear
axis, if `"auto"`, the minor tick interval is calculated as a fifth
of the tickInterval. If `undefined`, minor ticks are not shown.

On logarithmic axes, the unit is the power of the value. For example,
setting the minorTickInterval to 1 puts one tick on each of 0.1, 1,
10, 100 etc. Setting the minorTickInterval to 0.1 produces 9 ticks
between 1 and 10, 10 and 100 etc.

If user settings dictate minor ticks to become too dense, they don't
make sense, and will be ignored to prevent performance problems.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorTickLength
title: minorTickLength
description: The pixel length of the minor tick marks.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorTickPosition
title: minorTickPosition
description:
The position of the minor tick marks relative to the axis line.
 Can be one of `inside` and `outside`.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorTickWidth
title: minorTickWidth
description: The pixel width of the minor tick mark.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorTicks
title: minorTicks
description:
Enable or disable minor ticks. The interval between the minor ticks
can be controlled either by the
[minorTicksPerMajor](#xAxis.minorTicksPerMajor) setting, or as an
absolute [minorTickInterval](#xAxis.minorTickInterval) value.

On a logarithmic axis, minor ticks are laid out based on a best
guess, attempting to enter an approximate number of minor ticks
between each major tick based on
[minorTicksPerMajor](#xAxis.minorTicksPerMajor).

Prior to v6.0.0, ticks were enabled in auto layout by setting
`minorTickInterval` to `"auto"`.

name: navigator-yAxis-minorTicksPerMajor
title: minorTicksPerMajor
description:
The number of minor ticks per major tick. Works for `linear`,
`logarithmic` and `datetime` axes.

For radial axes in gauges, the default value is 10.

name: navigator-yAxis-offset
title: offset
description:
The distance in pixels from the plot area to the axis line.
A positive offset moves the axis with its line, labels and ticks
away from the plot area. This is typically used when two or more
axes are displayed on the same side of the plot. With multiple
axes the offset is dynamically adjusted to avoid collision, this
can be overridden by setting offset explicitly.

For radial axes in gauges, the offset can be a percentage string, and
defaults to render the line and ticks on the inside of the pane and
plot bands (since v13). Labels are not affected by the offset in
radial axes.

name: navigator-yAxis-panningEnabled
title: panningEnabled
description:
Whether to pan axis. If `chart.panning` is enabled, the option
allows to disable panning on an individual axis.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-acrossPanes
title: acrossPanes
description: Flag to decide if plotBand should be rendered across all panes.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-borderColor
title: borderColor
description: Border color for the plot band. Also requires `borderWidth` to be set.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-borderRadius
title: borderRadius
description:
Border radius for the plot band. Applies only to gauges. Can be a pixel
value or a percentage, for example `50%`.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-borderWidth
title: borderWidth
description: Border width for the plot band. Also requires `borderColor` to be set.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-className
title: className
description:
A custom class name, in addition to the default `highcharts-plot-band`,
to apply to each individual band.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-color
title: color
description: The color of the plot band.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-events
title: events
description:
An object defining mouse events for the plot band. Supported properties
are `click`, `mouseover`, `mouseout`, `mousemove`.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-events-click
title: click
description: Click event on a plot band.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-events-mousemove
title: mousemove
description: Mouse move event on a plot band.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-events-mouseout
title: mouseout
description: Mouse out event on the corner of a plot band.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-events-mouseover
title: mouseover
description: Mouse over event on a plot band.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-from
title: from
description:
The start position of the plot band in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-id
title: id
description: An id used for identifying the plot band in Axis.removePlotBand.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label
title: label
description: Text labels for the plot bands

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-align
title: align
description:
Horizontal alignment of the label. Can be one of "left", "center" or
"right".

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-allowOverlap
title: allowOverlap
description: Whether or not the label can be hidden if it overlaps with another label.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-inside
title: inside
description: Wether or not the text of the label can exceed the width of the label.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-rotation
title: rotation
description: Rotation of the text label in degrees .

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-style
title: style
description:
CSS styles for the text label.

In styled mode, the labels are styled by the
`.highcharts-plot-band-label` class.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-text
title: text
description: The string text itself. A subset of HTML is supported.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-textAlign
title: textAlign
description:
The text alignment for the label. While `align` determines where the
texts anchor point is placed within the plot band, `textAlign` determines
how the text is aligned against its anchor point. Possible values are
"left", "center" and "right". Defaults to the same as the `align` option.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-useHTML
title: useHTML
description:
Whether to [use HTML](https://www.highcharts.com/docs/chart-concepts/labels-and-string-formatting#html)
to render the labels.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-verticalAlign
title: verticalAlign
description:
Vertical alignment of the label relative to the plot band. Can be one of
"top", "middle" or "bottom".

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-x
title: x
description:
Horizontal position relative the alignment. Default varies by
orientation.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-label-y
title: y
description:
Vertical position of the text baseline relative to the alignment. Default
varies by orientation.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-to
title: to
description:
The end position of the plot band in axis units.

On datetime axes, the value can be given as a timestamp or a date string.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotBands-zIndex
title: zIndex
description:
The z index of the plot band within the chart, relative to other
elements. Using the same z index as another element may give
unpredictable results, as the last rendered element will be on top.
Values from 0 to 20 make sense.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotLines-acrossPanes
title: acrossPanes
description: Flag to decide if plotLine should be rendered across all panes.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotLines-className
title: className
description:
A custom class name, in addition to the default `highcharts-plot-line`,
to apply to each individual line.

name: navigator-yAxis-plotLines-color
title: color
